input.title: Handle overlapping days in dedupe.ts for consecutive uploads
input.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The current duplicate detection logic doesn't handle overlapping days when two statements are uploaded one after the other. Introducing a more robust mechanism to handle overlaps by integrating time-based batching or sequential processing steps could mitigate this issue.

text:
The issue with duplicate detection missing overlapping days is due to the logic in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts`. The current implementation of the dedupe function uses a single pass to identify and drop duplicates within the same set of rows or with respect to a pre-existing set of keys (seen). The problem described occurs when two separate uploads contain overlapping dates, and this logic is not designed to handle two distinct uploads received in succession within a short timeframe.

For this reason, I will mark the issue as a `bug` and proceed to create a draft pull request suggesting a more robust handling of overlapping statements by potentially introducing a time-based check or a batch processing method to account for such overlaps.

Let's proceed with labeling the issue, creating the draft pull request, and adding a comment.
